info.title: HC_RL_CreateCustomerRefund
info.description: Makes one customer refund from one customer deposit, for part or all of what the deposit still holds. The body is the body of the REST call POST /services/rest/record/v1/customerRefund. This file describes only what differs from that call. It is one line of a customer refund batch (HC_MR_RunBatchFile), or one call.

accountId.description: The NetSuite account: 9745435 is production, 9745435-sb1 is the sandbox.

get.description: Answers this OpenAPI file, the version deployed in this account.

post.description: Steps: check the required fields; answer the refund with the same externalId when there is one; otherwise transform the deposit named in deposit.items[0].doc into a refund, set externalId, paymentMethod, tranDate, memo and each top-level custom field, apply that deposit's own line for deposit.items[0].amount, and save. Differences from the REST call: (1) the same externalId twice answers the refund that exists, where REST refuses the second call; (2) success answers { id, existing }; (3) only the first deposit line is read; (4) an amount above what the deposit holds is refused and nothing is saved; (5) every other REST field is ignored, and customer and currency come from the deposit.

200.description: The refund made, or the one that was already there.

400.description: The error, thrown with its name and message. Nothing is made.

Request.description: The REST body. A top-level field whose name starts with cust is set as given; a reference's id is taken, and a date in text is read as tranDate is.

externalId.description: The refund's key, named by the caller. A second call with the same key makes no second refund.

amount.description: The amount, rounded to two places. At most what the deposit still holds.

existing.description: true when nothing was made because the record was already there; false when this call made it.

code.description: The error's name: MISSING_FIELD when a required field is missing, DEPOSIT_NOT_OPEN when the deposit has no open line, AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_DUE when amount is above what it holds, or NetSuite's own.

message.description: NetSuite's SuiteScriptError as JSON text. Parse it for its name and message.

externalDocs.description: The body fields, custom fields included, as this account defines them: GET /services/rest/record/v1/metadata-catalog/customerRefund with the header Accept: application/swagger+json
